steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.words: A song puts words on its melody: one syllable on each note, written under it (in the lane too). A hyphen, as in “pen-ny”, means the word goes on to the next note. Sing the vowels long and the consonants short and clear, and keep the melody in tune: the words ride on it.
steps.hotCross: “Hot Cross Buns”, with its words. The music waits at each note: sing the syllable under it, in tune.
steps.hotCrossAlong: Now in time, with the piano playing along. With headphones, the microphone doesn’t hear the piano; without them, turn the piano down or off.
steps.auClair: “Au clair de la lune”, which you read from the staff in Unit 7, now with its words and the piano. Sing it in time.
